summary:
Plan of w185 written to .shop/scratch/2-plan/plan.md.
D1: an answered proposal goes to the round that asked, read from its last log move into awaiting-answer (drafted means gate, so apply; approved means formulate, so formulate; no move means apply, which keeps r70 green). Rests on r70, r116 and design-decision/a-ruling-returns-to-the-asking-stage.
D2: a formulate round's questions are written under ## Questions. With questions the proposal goes approved -> awaiting-answer, or stays awaiting-answer when the round was re-run from answers; with none it goes to formulated (r83, r112, r113).
D3: an apply round's change list replaces the proposal's adds, changes and removes on its capability, with r107's capability check; no list keeps the lists integrate wrote (r114, r92).
D4: pull_through holds a round's Refused, takes the other nodes through (other rounds, pull, draft, set_done), then raises it (r115, r88, r111).
No test broken; the retired r83 deprecated scenario is deleted. New step module supervision_formulate_steps.py, with a CLAUDE.md row if the implementer judges it needed.
